messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 500s on /v1/generate - routing_policy=fallback-by-pin triggered 14:12 UTC
Alice: grabbing this - seeing spike in errors and a bunch of traces showing 'incompatible_variant' rejects
Ben: pinging runtime team, can you share which model variant was pinned for the tenant id in the traces?
Maria: looking... traces show requests from tenant `acct-3428` were pinned to model `open-gen-chat-v1` but incoming request type is `embed` (embedding request) -> runtime tried fallback to `open-embed-instruct-v1`? that mismatch caused a schema validation error and 500s
Sam: client reported degraded search relevance - this tenant does embeddings for search ranking, they hit 5xxs for ~6m
Cindy: I've opened a quick support case with the customer and told them we're investigating; they're seeing "internal server error" in prod search logs
Alice: timeline: around 14:07 UTC config change deployed to routing policy service - likely a pin/variant change. deploy-bot can you surface the deploy?
deploy-bot: deploy: routing-service v2.14.1 by mariar at 14:06:23 UTC - config: fallback_policy=pin-prefer, pin_map updated for acct-3428 -> open-gen-chat-v1
Ben: that sounds like the root cause. Pin maps should match request types. If a pin points to a chat/generation-only variant and an embed request hits it, we must route to a compatible variant or reject gracefully, not 500
Maria: logs showing reject path: `validate_request_for_variant` raised IncompatibleSchemaError -> bubbled up -> 500. No graceful fallback to a compatible embed model due to policy ordering for this tenant (pin had precedence)
Alice: mitigation: rollback the pin for acct-3428 and add an immediate routing override to map embed requests to `open-embed-instruct-v1` until we fix policy logic. Ben, can you apply a hotfix to routing-service?
Ben: applying override now (hotpatch): `routing.override.put acct-3428 embed open-embed-instruct-v1 --ephemeral 1h`
Ben: override applied at 14:20:11 UTC, starting to see 200s again for embed traces
Cindy: customer confirms errors stopped around 14:22 UTC, they're running repro locally and seeing search responses restored :relieved:
Maria: pushing a follow-up config change: ensure pin entries include allowed_request_types metadata and runtime validates before accepting pin updates. I'll send a patch in 30m
Sam: ETA to customer-facing postmortem? they want a short note in 2 hours. Also need to know if any data loss or incorrect outputs were served during window
Alice: quick impact assessment: ~6 minutes of elevated 5xx between 14:16-14:22 UTC, roughly 1200 embed requests failed, no successful responses with wrong shape were returned (we returned 500s), so no corrupted embeddings persisted. Customer search index ingestion retried and completed after backfill - Cindy pls confirm
Cindy: confirmed ingestion retried automatically and completed by 15:05 UTC. No data loss reported on their side but they saw customer-facing search blips for ~40 minutes because of retries and downstream throttling
Ben: next steps for ops: 1) revert faulty pin in pin-store (done) 2) add validation on pin writes 3) change fallback ordering to try compatible variant before hard-failing 4) add metrics for 'incompatible_variant' rejections
Maria: I'll open PR with tests that enforce request_type compatibility on pin assignment and add a runtime check that converts incompatible-pinned requests to a soft-fallback path (logs + metric)
Alice: I'll own the incident write-up and customer note. Ben/Maria please add links to PRs and deploys in the postmortem.
Sam: thumbs up. Also flag this for product review: pin UX needs a warning/confirmation when pinning cross-type variants
Alice: recording timeline and actions in incident tracker. If anyone has traces or specific example trace IDs, paste here for the postmortem.
Ben: example trace: trace-id=01-abc123-def456, request-type=embedding, routed-variant=open-gen-chat-v1, error=IncompatibleSchemaError
Maria: adding soft fix ticket: RUNTIME-657: relax fallback ordering for pinned variants and RUNTIME-658: pin validation on write
Alice: thanks all, I'll close the page once postmortem is posted and customer note sent
incidents-bot: incident acknowledged by Alice at 14:24 UTC, severity=P2, incident channel locked
